answer: Locks are logged in voyage, expire in vertex, and tide lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 143 aliases therefore needs 190 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2020 identities would post 1297 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
